notes.title: update #13 - v1.15.8 available... (quickfix for connection errors)
notes.content:
Hi guys, 

This version fixes the infamous all-new connection-to-master-server-failed - bug. 

For all of you guys understanding code - THIS was the culprit:
[code]
int32 v4napi_sockets::getSocketError ()
{
#ifdef V4OS_WINDOWS_WIN32_XP
	return WSAGetLastError ();
#else
	return errno;
#endif
}
[/code]

Whoever can guess the bug here, gets awarded the [b]vertex4 Award of Excellence in Coding Clairvoyance[/b].

Cheers and sorry for the hassle,
Roman

There has been a versioning mishap for the newly released mac version of sunage causing it to behave like a cracked version. (doing superweird stuff like green screening, burning units and a lot of other no-gos).

Thats fixed now -> just let steam update the game and you're good to go.

Cheers, and sorry for the inconvenience,
Roman
